title: tripsacum hirsutum
intro: Tripsacum hirsutum, commonly known as Broomcorn millets or Broom corn, is a type of grass native to North America. It is a wild grass with several health benefits, including the ability to lower cholesterol levels and prevent diabetes due to its high fiber and antioxidant content. The therapeutic actions of Tripsacum hirsutum include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, which can help to reduce inflammation, protect against cell damage, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of Tripsacum hirsutum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
